Jharkhand Foundation Day: 26 sal ka huaa jharkhand, BJYM adhyaksh shashank ne kya kaha?
Jharkhand ne apni sthapna ke 26 sal pure kar lie hain. jharkhand sthapna divas ke mauke par BJYM (bhartiy janta yuva morcha) ke adhyaksh shashank ne rajy ke 26 sal ke saphar, vikas, yuvaon ke muddon aur bhavishy ki chunautiyon par apni bat rakhi.
